description:
[Pan-European cash payment limit audit. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Enforces the mandatory €10,000 pan-EU cash limit under Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 Article 80 and stricter national ceilings (Italy €5k, France/Spain €1k), detecting artificial installment smurfing.
Usage: Pass transaction amount, country, and residential status to assess legal validity of physical cash settlement.
Returns: JSON object with { countryIso2: string, totalCashAmountEur: number, applicableCeilingEur: number, isPaymentPermitted: boolean, isCeilingExceeded: boolean, linkedTransactionsSmurfingDetected: boolean, sanctionsRisk: object }.

countryIso2.description: 2-letter EU country code where the commercial transaction takes place

isCustomerResidentInCountry.description: Whether paying customer has tax residence in the transaction country

isTraderInGoodsOrServices.description: Whether payment is made to a person trading in goods or providing services

transactions.description: Single transaction or series of linked cash payments within a 30-day window

amountEur.description: Amount paid in physical cash in EUR

name: eu_cash_payment_limit_audit
